marks.gloss_en: הכי השתא?! התם משתא ובארוכי בהדי הדדי לא אפשר, הכא אפשר דשחיט בחדא ומכסי בחדא -- there drinking and blessing together is impossible; here he can slaughter with one [hand] and cover with one
blood mixed with water: if it has the appearance of blood, he is obligated to cover
הכא כתיב מיעוטא -- וכסהו: the restriction in the verse grounds the exemption once covered (no SupportKind names a derivation from a verse)
התם לא כתיב מיעוטא, הכא כתיב מיעוטא -- וכסהו (= p_hatam_lo_ktiv_miuta, p_vechisahu_miuta)
there [returning a lost object] no restriction is written
מאי שנא מהשבת אבדה, דאמר מר: השב -- אפילו מאה פעמים? -- a lost object is returned again and again; why is covering not repeated once the blood is uncovered?
'return [them]' -- [one must return a lost object] even a hundred times
the mishna: he covered it and it became uncovered -- he is exempt from covering [again]
זאת אומרת -- since R' Yochanan obligates once it is uncovered again, the wind's covering did not permanently reject the mitzva
וכי חזר ונתגלה מאי הוי? הא אידחי ליה -- and when it became uncovered again, what of it? it was already rejected [from covering when the wind covered it]
זאת אומרת: אין דיחוי אצל מצות (= p_rp_ein_dichui_bemitzvot)
R' Yochanan: they taught this [obligation] only where it again became uncovered
ומאי שנא מהא דתניא: השוחט ונבלע דם בקרקע חייב לכסות -- blood swallowed by the ground stays covered, yet he is obligated
התם כשרשומו ניכר -- there, where its mark is recognisable (= p_okimta_reshumo_nikar)
the baraita: one who slaughters and the blood was absorbed in the ground -- he is obligated to cover
מנין שחייב לכסות? שנאמר ואמר לבני ישראל -- אזהרה לכל בני ישראל (no SupportKind names a derivation from a verse)
'and he shall pour out [its blood] and cover it' -- the one who poured shall cover
דכתיב כי הנה יוצר הרים ובורא רוח -- the heretic reads the two participles as two creators
תא שמע: Rebbi offered the cup of blessing or forty gold coins, and the bat kol said the cup of blessing is worth forty -- the figure of the 'blessing' alternative
שוטה, שפיל לסיפיה דקרא: ה' צבאות שמו -- the verse ends naming one God as former and creator; unanswered (לא מצא תשובה, 87a.8)
the heretic: He who formed mountains did not create wind, and He who created wind did not form mountains
'and he shall pour out and cover' -- with what he poured he shall cover, so that he not cover it with the foot
alternative 1: the ten coins are the reward for the mitzva -- so for Grace after Meals it is one [payment]
the heretic: give me three days' time and I will return you a rebuttal
Rebbi, I bring you good tidings: your enemy found no answer, fell from the roof and died
R' Yitzchak: that family still exists among the great of Rome, and it is called the family of bar Luyyanus
